purpose: gnssd3: gnssd2 + fix of the gnssd2 SIGBUS (alignment fault ESR 0x92000021 at `ldar` in the pthread_mutex_init shim on a 4-byte-aligned bionic mutex 0x...76c). Darwin mutex/cond objects now live in an n2mnld side table; libmnl's mutex/cond word holds only a 32-bit handle (0x80000000|index) accessed with 32-bit atomics; every 8-byte value in/out of libmnl memory (timespec, timeval, pthread_t, sigset, itimerspec, timer id, sincos, %n) goes through memcpy. Keeps the TPIDR_EL0 canary patch, the 10 s import trace and the fault handler. Same install as gnssd1/gnssd2 (installs over them in place); undo: guest-gnssd3-undo.sh (guest-gnssd1-undo.sh / guest-gnssd2-undo.sh equivalent). Kernel q10jfg (967ecf50) or q10jr11.
needs: payload-locbridge1 with args ['--fifo','/private/var/run/n2gnss.nmea'] to forward fixes to locationd (optional for the first run)
